annotations.title: Find models that fit a machine

description: Which tracked models run on a given GPU or Mac: measured GGUF weights + computed context cache + runtime overhead versus usable memory. Returns the best recommendation and every verdict (EXCELLENT/GOOD/TIGHT/OFFLOAD_REQUIRED/NOT_RECOMMENDED/UNKNOWN) with plain-language reasons, plus summary counts over all tracked models. For a short answer pass show "fits" (only models that run fully on the machine), a limit, or compact true (one row per model: name, quantization, verdict, total GB). The machine is a hardware id from list_hardware, several identical cards (count), or, for a machine that is not listed, a free memory figure (memory_gb, with type "mac" for unified memory); what a machine off the list assumes is said in hardware.assumptions.

compact.description: One short row per model instead of the full arithmetic and reasons.

count.description: How many identical graphics cards (default 1). Their memory adds up; the answer says what that assumes.

hardware.description: Hardware id or page slug, e.g. rtx-4090, mac-studio-m3-ultra-96gb. Leave it out when you pass memory_gb.

limit.description: At most this many rows, best first.

memory_gb.description: For a machine that is not on the list, instead of hardware: the memory of one graphics card, or of the Mac, in GB.

ram_gb.description: System RAM behind the card(s), for what spills over (default 32).

show.description: Which verdicts to list: all (default), fits (runs fully on the machine), fits_or_spills (also those that spill into system RAM).

type.description: What memory_gb describes: "gpu" (default, a plug-in card) or "mac" (unified memory).

name: find_fit
title: Find models that fit a machine
